title: Delivery Claims Recovery Desk: Found-Parcel Charge Calculation
content:
Recovery desk calculation of the charge for a parcel compensated under Delivery Claims as undelivered that has turned up and is kept.

**Calculation.** The found-parcel charge is the merchandise compensation booked on the claim for the line kept (the merchandise refund entries on that line, tax share included), for the units compensated on that line, all of which the customer keeps, rounded to the nearest cent on the final figure. Goodwill Credit and delivery-charge refunds on the claim are not part of the charge.

## Inputs

| Input | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| line kept | the order line of the claim's merchandise refund entries — where refunds were booked on more than one line, the line of the most recent merchandise refund entry |
| merchandise compensation for the line | the sum of the claim's merchandise refund entries on that line, tax share included |
| units compensated on the line | the sum of the units on those entries; the customer keeps all of them |

The charge base is the merchandise compensation for the line kept.

## How the charge is assembled

Where courtesy rates apply to the charge, they are added together into one courtesy rate, which is applied once to the charge base. The courtesy-reduced figure is then multiplied by any share of it that is charged. Any label saving is then taken off. The charge is never below 0.00 and is rounded to the nearest cent on the final figure.

## Worked figure (hypothetical claim)

Two merchandise refund entries on the same line, 54.00 USD for 1 unit and 54.00 USD for 1 unit, each including its tax share: the merchandise compensation for the line is 108.00 USD for 2 units, and the found-parcel charge is 108.00 USD. A shipping fee refund of 9.95 USD and a Goodwill Credit standing on the same claim do not enter the charge.
